primary_sources.summary: FAULT is open drain. Recommended FAULT sink maximum is 10 mA; absolute pin voltage extends to 7 V. Operating IN is 2.5–6.5 V. FAULT low row uses 1 mA; off leakage maximum is 1 uA at 6.5 V. Overcurrent reporting is delayed 5–10 ms. Independent safe operation below UVLO is not guaranteed by normal rows.
The exact preserved orderable part is a six-pin DBV active-high latch-off switch with reverse blocking.

normal_accounting.sharing_inference: Neither resistor branch carries the whole motor AUX current in normal operation. Its individual endpoint allocation is exact; no harness or device pad equal sharing is assumed.

sequencing_and_faults: R54 pullup and U11014 IN use FIELD_5V; the topology change preserves both source node assignments. Actual full supply and local ground root/contact/drop are required in the joint candidate.
The 5.1 V planning pullup is below the IC absolute FAULT voltage and its zero-drop current is below the recommended sink limit; this does not qualify surge, ESD or below-UVLO logic behavior.

R54 pullup cannot by itself prove a valid healthy signal during startup, disabled switching, UVLO or loss of device power. Existing FAULT qualification and deliberately inhibited restart remain mandatory.

The copper before R55 can see a short fault above its 52.3 uA normal load. Retained TPS2553-1 current limiting, response, latchoff, charging energy and fault-loop thermal behavior remain separate obligations; no normal bleed-current capacity waiver is applied.

External AUX5 backfeed, input-off operation and output-capacitor discharge remain subject to the existing IC reverse-blocking and harness fault contract. The TI 1 uA reverse-leak row is only VIN=0,VOUT=6.5 V,TJ=25 C and is not a full-temperature guarantee.
new_static_strap_reference_scope: Static resistor power feed; source-rooted DC supply and local return required. All retained old reference coverage remains absolute. No fast clock shadow requirement is inferred solely from the FIELD5 net name.
